# Welcome

I am a **Postdoctoral Scholar** in Environmental Health at the University of Southern California.

My research focuses on:

- Air pollution and climate-related exposures  
- Neighborhood and built environment impacts
- Transportation policy (Zero Emission Vehicle adoption)

## About Me

<img src="images/profile.jpg" width="180" class="profile">

I am an environmental epidemiologist with a PhD in Population Health Sciences from Harvard University, with a focus on environmental epidemiology. My research integrates epidemiology, biostatistics, and environmental science to understand how environmental and contextual factors jointly shape exposure and vulnerability. Using population-level data, I aim to generate real-world evidence that informs public health policy and supports healthier communities.


---

## Research Interests

- Environmental epidemiology  
- Climate and health, particularly extreme heat and air pollution in the interaction between outdoor and indoor environments  
- Policy-relevant and translational research  
- Causal inference methods for population health
